subject: Senior Full Stack Developer — 7 yrs, Python, Node.js, React & AWS Expertise in Gen AI
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I hope this email finds you well. I am excited to express my interest in the Full Stack Developer role at your organization. With 7 years of professional experience in software development, I have honed my skills in developing, enhancing, and maintaining applications using Python, Node.js, and React, making me a strong fit for this position.

In my current role at Impressico Business Solutions, I successfully optimized our CI/CD deployment pipelines, reducing build and deployment failures by 90%. Additionally, I have implemented effective API integration and caching strategies, leading to a 25% performance improvement in our applications. My proficiency with PL/SQL, combined with extensive experience in AWS services, including Lambda and S3, directly aligns with your requirements.

Moreover, I am adept at building and documenting cloud-native architectures while ensuring compliance with security best practices. I thrive in collaborative environments, where I've successfully gathered business requirements and translated them into technical specifications with cross-functional teams.

Attached are my resume and a fitment report for your review. Thank you for considering my application; I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Warm regards,

Virender Kumar
